title: Zoning map change for 100-12 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills
summary: This application would amend the zoning map to allow an R7-1/C1-2 site to become R9X/C2-4 and adjust nearby districts at 100-12 Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills, Queens. Combined with a related text amendment, it would enable a 21-story mixed-use building with about 280,800 square feet of floor area, 389 apartments including 97 income-restricted units, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. A public hearing was held October 6, 2026.
